site-enemies: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW transparent pixel-art sprite atlas for a dark fantasy survival game. WIDE LANDSCAPE canvas, aspect ratio about 5:3. Column 2: pale slender cave lizard, low stance, long tail. Column 3: stocky dark olive armored lizard, heavy jaw and dorsal ridges. Column 4: brown shaggy single-headed wolf-like beast. Column 5: scarred single-headed wolf matriarch with massive broad shoulders and heavy paws. The beasts can be smaller on this sheet; runtime enlarges them independently. Do NOT fill the whole canvas with oversized creatures. NO overlapping bounding boxes. No cropped feet or tails. True alpha transparent background, no floor, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no backdrop.
